prerequisite: The actual study sessions must be run by the owner-developer on RHW-001 using the preregistered protocol defined in task_6_1_3 through task_6_1_5 of preregistration.json. No automated process can substitute for the human participant performing the path-finding tasks.
blocking_reason: The 3D spike implementation (task 6.2) must first be fully integrated and deployed to a runnable build on RHW-001 before study sessions can begin. The 3D path explorer must be sufficiently operational to collect real path-finding trial data under WebKitGTK; without a working renderer the study fixture cannot be navigated in the 3D condition.
dependency_note: The spike technical implementation (task 6.2 — 3D path explorer renderer, z-axis from authority-backed cosine similarity, WebGL context-loss fallback) must be runnable on RHW-001 before any study data collection begins. The study cannot start until the 3D path explorer is working sufficiently to complete path-finding trials end-to-end.

notes.task_6_1_3: Participants, fixtures, training, counterbalancing, exclusions, measures, analysis, and context-loss/a11y observation protocol — all frozen.
notes.task_6_1_4: GO/NO-GO conjunctive thresholds (task benefit, FPS, idle-quiet, resource parity, a11y parity, core-task parity, FOSS closure) — all frozen.

session_plan.rationale: Single participant; ABBA balances order effects (learning, fatigue, time-of-day) across sessions. Session order is fixed in preregistration and must not change.
session_plan.extension_rule: If more than 4 sessions are required to reach 30 valid pairs per condition, extend with pattern ABBA|ABBA|... maintaining balance. Extension must be decided before any additional sessions begin, not after inspecting results.

path_pairs.status: PENDING — must be generated by CMD-MG-STUDY-PATHS and appended to preregistration.json before the first session

data_schema._comment: Schema describing session log files that will be created when study sessions run. Each session produces one session_N.json in session_logs/. Fields are defined by the frozen measures in preregistration.json task_6_1_3. The schema_type field identifies the record kind.

session_id.description: Session number (1–4 for primary ABBA plan; higher for extensions).

condition.description: The experimental condition for this session.

start_timestamp_utc.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of session start (before training).

end_timestamp_utc.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of session end (after last trial or exclusion).

hardware_id.description: Reference hardware identifier; must be RHW-001.

path_pairs_used.description: Array of training path pair IDs used (from mg-small-v2).

passed.description: true if both training paths identified correctly within 5-minute limit.

steps_failed.description: List of step names that failed keyboard navigation (empty if pass=true).

trials.description: One entry per scheduled trial in this session (included or excluded).

trial_id.description: Sequential trial index within this session (1-based).

path_pair_id.description: Identifier matching one of the 30 immutable_path_pairs in preregistration.json. Format: 'pair_NN'.

included.description: true if the trial is valid for analysis; false if excluded.

exclusion_reason.description: Populated when included=false. Must match one of the registered trial-level exclusion criteria.

task_completion_time_ms.description: Elapsed ms from path query dispatch to correct entity confirmed in Inspector. null if trial excluded before clock stop.

error_count.description: Count of incorrect Inspector entity activations before the correct destination entity is confirmed. null if trial excluded.

path_identification_accuracy.description: 1 if participant traversed the exact preregistered path; 0 if alternate route taken to reach destination; null if excluded.

time_to_first_correct_node.description: Ms from query dispatch to first intermediate node on the preregistered path being activated in Inspector. null if excluded or not reached.

context_loss_events.description: Zero or more WebGL context loss events during this trial (3D condition only).

fallback_completed.description: true if 2D/list fallback rendered the same path result within 2 seconds.

query_dispatch_timestamp_ms.description: window.performance.now() at path query dispatch (measurement clock start).

entity_confirmed_timestamp_ms.description: window.performance.now() at correct entity_confirmed event (measurement clock stop).

session_excluded.description: true if the entire session is excluded by session-level exclusion criteria.

session_exclusion_reason.description: Populated when session_excluded=true. Must match one of the registered session-level exclusion criteria.

context_loss_simulation_verified.description: For 3D sessions: true if at least one simulated WebGL context loss was induced post-session using the renderer debug trigger to verify fallback path is functional.

session_logs.description: One JSON file per study session, conforming to data_schema field definitions. N = 1..4 (or higher if sessions are extended). Created by the owner when sessions run.

trial_data_aggregated.description: Aggregated trial-level data across all valid sessions, with per-condition lists of (path_pair_id, task_completion_time_ms, error_count, path_identification_accuracy, time_to_first_correct_node) tuples. Excludes all excluded trials and sessions. Used as direct input to analysis.
trial_data_aggregated.status: PENDING — created after all sessions complete

analysis_results.description: Statistical analysis output: Wilcoxon W and p-values per primary measure, median percentage differences (effect sizes), 95% bootstrap CIs (seed 0x4D475230, 10,000 samples), valid pair counts, exclusion counts and reasons, trial-level time series for learning-effect inspection, secondary measure summaries, and final GO/NO-GO verdict against task_benefit_threshold from preregistration.json task_6_1_4.
analysis_results.status: PENDING — created after all sessions complete and aggregation is done

preregistration_reference.description: The frozen protocol document containing all study parameters. Must not be modified after data collection begins.
preregistration_reference.status: EXISTS — partially complete (task_6_1_4 and task_6_1_5 sections deferred until F5 is signed)
